description_en: Queries the configuration of unusual logon detection rules for servers
description_zh: 查询服务器异常登录检测规则的配置信息
name: DescribeLoginBaseConfigs

parameters.help_en: Settings for paged query. The number of logon configuration entries to display on each page during paging. Default value: 5, which indicates that five logon configuration entries are displayed on each page
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的登录配置信息的数量。默认值为5，表示每页显示5条登录配置信息
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of logon configuration to query. Valid values:
login_common_location: common logon location.
login_common_ip: common logon IP address.
login_common_time: common logon time.
login_common_account: common logon account
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的登录配置信息的类型。取值：
login_common_location：常用登录地。
login_common_ip：常用登录IP。
login_common_time：常用登录时间。
login_common_account：常用登录账号
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1, which indicates that the first page is returned
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The selection mode for the assets on which the policy takes effect. This parameter is in JSON format and contains the following fields:

Target: the UUID of the server to add or delete, or the ID of the server group.

If the targetType parameter is set to uuid, this parameter specifies the UUID of the server. If the targetType parameter is set to groupId, this parameter specifies the ID of the server group. If the targetType parameter is set to global, this parameter is set to a hyphen (-).

targetType: the selection mode for the assets on which the policy takes effect. Valid values:
    - uuid: queries by individual server.
    - groupId: queries by server group.
    - global: queries all servers
parameters.help_zh:
策略生效的资产的选择模式。此参数为JSON格式，包含以下参数：

Target：要添加或删除的服务器的UUID或服务器所在的分组ID。

当参数targetType的取值为uuid时，该参数取值为服务器的UUID。当参数targetType的取值为groupId时，该参数的取值为服务器所在的分组ID。当参数targetType的取值为global时，该参数取值为中划线（-）。

targetType：生效资产的选择模式。取值：
    - uuid：按单个服务器查询。
    - groupId：按照服务器分组查询。
    - global：表示查询所有服务器
parameters.name: target

schema.description_en: The response data of unusual logon detection rule configurations
schema.description_zh: 异常登录检测规则的配置返回数据

BaseConfigs.description_en: The list of logon configuration details
BaseConfigs.description_zh: 登录配置信息的详情列表

EndTime.description_en:
The end time of the common logon time range.

The time is in the HH:mm format, which represents a daily time range in the 24-hour clock
EndTime.description_zh:
常用登录时间的结束时间。

该字段时间格式为HH:mm，表示24小时制的每日时间段

Remark.description_en: The remark information displayed for the corresponding configuration
Remark.description_zh: 对应配置备注显示的信息

StartTime.description_en:
The start time of the common logon time range.

The time is in the HH:mm format, which represents a daily time range in the 24-hour clock
StartTime.description_zh:
常用登录时间的开始时间。

该字段时间格式为HH:mm，表示24小时制的每日时间段

TargetList.description_en: The list of details about the servers on which the rule takes effect
TargetList.description_zh: 规则生效的服务器的详细信息列表

items.description_en: The details about a server on which the rule takes effect
items.description_zh: 规则生效的服务器的详细信息

Target.description_en: The UUID of the server on which the rule takes effect, or the ID of the server group to which the server belongs
Target.description_zh: 规则生效的服务器的UUID或者服务器其所在的分组ID

TargetType.description_en:
The selection mode for the assets on which the rule takes effect. Valid values:

uuid: added by individual asset.
groupId: added by server group.
global: all assets are selected
TargetType.description_zh:
生效资产的选择模式。取值：

uuid：按单个资产添加。
groupId：按照服务器分组添加。
global：表示选择所有资产

UuidCount.description_en: The number of servers on which the rule takes effect
UuidCount.description_zh: 规则生效的服务器的数量

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query. This is used for paging through the results
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of logon configuration entries displayed on each page in a paged query. This is used for paging through the results. Default value: 20, which indicates that 20 logon configuration entries are displayed on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的登录配置信息的数量。默认值为20，表示每页显示20条登录配置信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of logon configuration entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的登录配置信息的总数量
